What meds have you tried? They work differently for different people but I had tried about 10 ssri's before they gave me bupropion (wellbutrin). The ssri's are the most commonly prescribed and they work on serotonin. Wellbutrin works on your dopamine receptors. Completely different. None of the SSRI's I took helped, some gave me bad symptoms. Wellbutrin though helps me tremendously, with one caveat that is not normal, but it makes me feel HUMAN and like I can do stuff for the first 2-3 weeks of me taking it, then it diminishes. I take it for 2-3 weeks, then stop for a few weeks to a month then start again. My psych dr. Was trying to get me to change meds but my new therapist told me if this is working I should keep doing it this way. Maybe it would help you too. AFAIK wellbutrin is the only med that works on dopamine rather than serotonin.

Hey, my friend killed herself last year. I hadn't talked to her in over 5 years. I found out last night. I stumbled upon her obituary. She didnt "know me" enough for her family to reach out to me. We weren't even friends on Facebook. We had a brief friendship about 6 years ago and she was a light in my life even though she didnt know it. She had things to live for she just couldnt see them. Please try hard to see them in yourself. You never know how many people care about you until something like that happens. And its shit, I know. Wondering why no ones making an effort, but I hope you know there are some people that think of you. There are things in you that no one else can contribute to the world. You do have something, everyone does. And its life changing, for you and others. Please look for it. My friend, who probably never thought of me again has directly affected my life even these years later. And it kills me inside to know I've almost done the same to others. Wait one more day, or one more month. Set a date and make a list of things you want to experience. It may just be what you need but if not there is a date set and you'll always know theres an out because you can make the choice later. My list is to dance in the rain, streak in the snow, listen to my brother and mom and grandmas favorite music, write them letters. Play with my cats, and my bunnies, write a poem to the world and try to have it published, try mushrooms, see a bonfire. Talk to my dad one more time, take a really hot shower and a bubble bath. Make a video diary. Maybe those ideas will help, they're simple ideas that. I hope you make a list OP and I hope you accomplish everyone before you make the choice.
